finding.text: The live proof can't be seen outside the worktree: `shots/` is gitignored (`.gitignore:210`, `**/shots/`), so `shots/v2-400.png` and `shots/v2-1920.png`, which the closing log line in `session.jsonl` cites, never reach the repo. A fresh agent starting from this folder has no proof to open. Move the two pngs to a tracked name (for example `proof/`, as the voice-sessions task did) and point the log line at it.

Deliverable 2 holds: `page_tools.js:772` `nest_agents` puts a `session-fast`/`voice-assistant` row under the `session-smart` row that has the same `parent_session`, and `parent: "sessions"` stays on all three seats (`Sessions.js:1209/1221/1229`). `seat-cost.test.mjs` passes ("4 passed", re-run here), and the log names `cost_parent` as the alternative.

Few people will see this change. The voice session's total already summed both seats (log line 3: `AISession.js:609`), and `nest_agents` only runs for registry rows that have no Session entry (the `unlinked` list at `page_tools.js:820`). If both seats get Session entries, `entry_children` keeps them as siblings and the smart seat's own total still leaves out the fast seat. Worth checking on one live voice session after the Servex restart.

The test calls `nest_agents` on hand-made rows. Nothing tests the real path where `agents_under` (`Agents.js:768`) now returns `parent_session`. One assertion on that row shape would protect the link the fix depends on.

The live proof shows that at 1920 the desktop drawer has no v2 chip, so Chat v2 only appears on the sheet (log line 2). That is a real gap for the parent brief's Part 8 ("seen in Chat v2"). Record it as an open item on the parent task, not only here.

Docs: the sentence went into `Servex/readme.md` (agents/ row) rather than `Servex/agents/session-fast.md`. Commit 5b76baa99 explains why: session-fast.md is the seat's prompt. The new test is indexed there too. Nothing else is stale.
Sessions.test.mjs and session-entries did not run (no node_modules in the worktree, per the log). Only seat-cost (4) and session-state (13) have pass counts, so run the rest after the merge.
